en: Vintage multi‑view postcard showing four interior photographs of a Jesuit boys' college: a grand assembly hall with rows of chairs and a stage, a richly decorated chapel with altar and wall paintings, a recreation room where boys in uniforms play table tennis and other games, and a large classroom with many wooden desks where students are studying. Hungarian captions label each view and identify the institution as the Pius College in Pécs. The reverse side is a standard divided postcard back printed in Hungarian, dated 1933 and crediting the Budapest publisher Monostory György.
